infra.description: The API Worker resource and the hosts, RPC path, and app name both instances derive from.

shared.description: The RPC contract the CLI and the server agree on, with its Auth Cannotation. Browser-safe.

server.description: The Consumer Backend: the handlers read Current Auth; the host runs Server-Side Verification and serves the group over HTTP.
The host wraps the handlers; handlers know nothing about HTTP.

cli.description: The CLI: Device Login and the Session Store from auth-toolkit, an RPC client that carries the Session, and the commands.

entry.description: One file per host, each a few lines around the RPC host: Cloudflare Worker, Node via srvx.

cli-app.description: Entries and the CLI read configuration from infra. The server and the CLI share only the contract. Dependencies point down.
